subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be resolved by documenting the existing pi-tui newline keys only, or should OpenClaw add a public configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main already supports newline insertion through pi-tui, but configurability would create a new TUI config or CLI contract that the repository policy treats as product-sensitive.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update docs and `/help` with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved TUI config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with default-compatibility tests.

options.title: Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Treat pi-tui's built-in newline support as enough and explicitly decide that docs/help and configurability are out of scope for now.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update docs and `/help` with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combination of prior issue review, original TUI ownership, docs history, and adjacent shortcut work.
